theorem OAllCharacterClosure.both_tests_full_PA_source_zero.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [LocallyCompactSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [addHaar.IsAddHaarMeasure] [addHaar.Regular]
  [inst_8 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [inst_9 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [inst_10 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_11 : SFinite mu] [inst_12 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] (a l r s : ℝ)
  (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi),
  have tests := ⋯;
  have A0 := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (DReview.sharp K phi) ⋯ ⋯;
  have A1 :=
    PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs
      (DReview.sharp K fun x => ↑(Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) * phi x) ⋯ ⋯;
  have S := (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection;
  have P := 1 - S;
  (P.comp A0).comp S = 0 ∧ (P.comp A1).comp S = 0 :=

  (∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) →
    ∀ (V : ℝ),
      0 < V →
        ∀ (U R : ι → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
          (Summable fun i => ‖U i‖ * ‖R i‖) →
            ∀ (p : E → X → ℝ),
              ReviewM.PositivePartition p →
                HasSum
                    (fun e =>
                      ∫ (x : X),
                        ↑(p e x) *
                          ∑' (i : ι), HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(U i)) (↑↑(R i)) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu)

                  ∑' (e : E),
                      ‖∫ (x : X),
                          ↑(p e x) *
                            ∑' (i : ι),
                              HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(U i)) (↑↑(R i)) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu‖ ≤
                    ∑' (i : ι), ‖U i‖ * ‖R i‖ :=

  (∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) →
    ∀ (vol : ℝ),
      0 < vol →
        ∀ (e0 eF : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu))
          (u v : ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
          (Summable fun i => ‖u i‖ * ‖v i‖) →
            ∀ (p : E → X → ℝ),
              ReviewM.PositivePartition p →
                Tendsto
                  (fun T =>
                    ∑' (e : E),
                      ‖∫ (x : X),
                            ↑(p e x) *
                              ∑' (i : ℕ),
                                HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b vol
                                  (↑↑((Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.finiteSourceSpan e0 eF Theta T).starProjection (v i)))
                                  (↑↑(u i)) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal vol • nu -
                          ∫ (x : X),
                            ↑(p e x) *
                              ∑' (i : ℕ),
                                HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b vol
                                  (↑↑((OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection (v i))) (↑↑(u i)) x
                                  x ∂ENNReal.ofReal vol • nu‖)
                  atTop (𝓝 0) :=

theorem ReviewM.full_source_arithmetic_shell_limit.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : NumberField K]
  [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (a l r s : ℝ) (places : ℕ → NumberField.FinitePlace K)
  (indent : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K → ℝ),
  Continuous indent →
    (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), 0 ≤ indent x) →
      (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K), HasSum (fun q => indent ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) q * x)) 1) →
        ∀ (u v : ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
          (Summable fun i => ‖u i‖ * ‖v i‖) →
            let W := JThetaAttachment.fullSourceSpan K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
            have Theta := OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
            let E := Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.finiteSourceSpan 0 0 Theta;
            have S := (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection;
            have w := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
            have p := NDivisorialShells.descendedMask K places indent;
            Tendsto
              (fun T =>
                ∑' (e : Option ℕ),
                  ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                        ↑(p e x) *
                          ∑' (i : ℕ),
                            HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel w 1 (↑↑((E T).starProjection (v i))) (↑↑(u i)) x x ∂mu -
                      ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                        ↑(p e x) * ∑' (i : ℕ), HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel w 1 (↑↑(S (v i))) (↑↑(u i)) x x ∂mu‖)
              atTop (𝓝 0) :=
⋯

  (u v : ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) (hc : Summable fun i => ‖u i‖ * ‖v i‖) :

  have w := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
